description:
At Glints, we are building the #1 tech-enabled recruitment and career discovery platform in Southeast Asia that helps people and organizations realize their human potential. Join the Glints Future Leaders Programme (GFLP) a structured internship designed to develop high-potential students into the next generation of regional leaders in the talent platform and HR tech industry.We're looking for an IT Intern to join our IT team in Batam, to support the day-to-day technology operations that keep our teams productive and secure across the region.
What You'll Be DoingProvide first-line IT support to employees: troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issuesManage employee onboarding and offboarding from the IT side: device setup, account provisioning, access managementMaintain and track IT asset inventory (laptops, monitors, peripherals) across officesOperate and monitor existing automation workflows for common IT requestsDocument IT processes and build runbooks to strengthen the team's knowledge baseSupport vendor coordination for device procurement, repairs, and logisticsWhy You Should Join UsRegional Exposure: Be immersed in our Southeast Asia Talent ecosystem, from Discovery Week to cross-functional regional projects, you’ll collaborate with teams and stakeholders across Singapore, Indonesia, and beyond.Guided Mentorship:  Every GFLP intern is paired with a Hiring Manager (Mentor) for professional growth and a Team Buddy for social integration within the assigned department.High-stakes Projects: Work on a key project independently or as a team to solve a real-business problem with potential for implementation.Leadership Access: Gathering and sharing sessions with our key leaders, founders and CEO, and participate in our key business review meetings.Post-Internship Recognition: At the end of your internship, you will present your key project/learnings to a leadership panel and receive a "GFLP Certificate" as an endorsement. You will also be evaluated based on your project and work outcomes for a full-time conversion opportunity (priority for final year students or graduates).Who We Are Looking ForFresh graduate or final-year student in IT, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related fieldGenuine curiosity about technology: you tinker, you Google, you figure things outStrong sense of responsibility - you don't drop the ballGood communication skills - you can explain technical things to non-technical peopleWillingness to learn fast and push yourself beyond your comfort zoneAny exposure to scripting, automation, or IT tools is a plus - but attitude matters more than experienceWilling to work from the Batam office (Working From Office, Monday–Friday)Let’s Realize Human Potential.At Glints, we are building the #1 tech-enabled recruitment and career discovery platform in Southeast Asia that helps people and organizations realize their human potential.We have impacted many lives but there’s still plenty to be done. If you’re ready to grow and make an impact, you’ve come to the right place.What is Glints?Glints is the leading talent ecosystem in Southeast Asia, with an enduring purpose of contributing to a world where people and organizations can realize their human potential. Today, Glints is the most well-funded and well-capitalized startup in the talent recruitment space in Southeast Asia, with over US$80M in total investments raised till date.Our tech-enabled approach to recruitment and career discovery connects more than 3 million candidates to their next dream opportunities. We have also supported more than 50,000 companies in finding top talent and doubling recruitment efficiency.Our agility and firm hold on our core purpose and values have allowed us to remain resilient and thrive through tumultuous times. In 2020, we were recognized by LinkedIn as one of the Top 10 Startups in Singapore. In 2022, we were featured in the top 20 of Nikkei-FT-Statista High-Growth Companies Asia-Pacific 2021 list. Moreover, we were also featured in the top 10 fastest-growing companies in Singapore by The Straits Times.Who We AreAt Glints, personal and professional growth are just as important as business growth. That's why we created the Glints Culture Code: #RIIBCOH. It defines our values, is what guides our decisions and actions, and is what makes us special.#RIIBCOH:1. Relentlessly Resourceful: Whatever it takes, just make it happen (ethically)2. Integrity: Have courage, be guided by the truth, don’t be afraid 3. Impact: Missionaries, not mercenaries4. Beginners’ Mindset: Stay humble, don’t be attached to ego5. Customer Obsessed: Customers First6. Ownership: Care intensely about the mission and take responsibility7. High Standards: Dream big and deliver epic outcomes fastWhere we workSince Glints was officially launched in Singapore in 2015, we've rapidly grown our footprint across Greater Southeast Asia to operate in Indonesia, Singapore, Vietnam, Taiwan, Malaysia and Philippines.Learn more about Glints and our culture at bit.ly/glintsculture.
